@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+## Use as a library
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+`{{value}}` HTML-escapes text, while `{{{value}}}` does not. The renderer also
+supports comments, `if`/`else`, and nested `each` blocks with `this` and
+`@index`.
+
+## CLI
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts template.txt data.json
+```
+
+The command writes only rendered output to stdout. Errors are written to stderr
+and result in a non-zero exit code.
+
+## Tests
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```

34: function parse(template: string): Node[] {
35:   const root: Node[] = [];
36:   let nodes = root;
37:   const stack: Frame[] = [];
38:   let cursor = 0;
39:   const token = /\{\{\{[\s\S]*?\}\}\}|\{\{[\s\S]*?\}\}/g;

41:   for (let match; (match = token.exec(template)); ) {

43:     cursor = token.lastIndex;
44:     const raw = match[0];
45:     const triple = raw.startsWith("{{{");
46:     const content = raw.slice(triple ? 3 : 2, triple ? -3 : -2).trim();

48:     if (content.startsWith("!")) continue;
49:     if (triple) {
50:       if (!content) parseError(template, match.index, "Empty interpolation");
51:       nodes.push({ type: "value", path: content, escaped: false });
52:       continue;
53:     }
54:     if (content.startsWith("#")) {
55:       const parts = content.slice(1).trim().split(/\s+/);
56:       const [kind, ...pathParts] = parts;
57:       if ((kind !== "if" && kind !== "each") || pathParts.length !== 1) {
58:         parseError(template, match.index, `Unknown or malformed block '${content}'`);
59:       }
60:       const block: BlockNode = { type: "block", kind, path: pathParts[0], body: [] };
61:       nodes.push(block);
62:       stack.push({ block, nodes, elseSeen: false });
63:       nodes = block.body;
64:       continue;
65:     }
66:     if (content === "else") {
67:       const frame = stack.at(-1);
68:       if (!frame) parseError(template, match.index, "'else' outside a block");
69:       if (frame.elseSeen) parseError(template, match.index, "Duplicate 'else'");
70:       frame.elseSeen = true;
71:       frame.block.alternate = [];
72:       nodes = frame.block.alternate;
73:       continue;
74:     }
75:     if (content.startsWith("/")) {
76:       const kind = content.slice(1).trim();
77:       const frame = stack.at(-1);
78:       if (!frame) parseError(template, match.index, `Unexpected closing block '${kind}'`);
79:       if (kind !== frame.block.kind) parseError(template, match.index, `Mismatched closing block '${kind}', expected '${frame.block.kind}'`);

95:   return (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
96: }

98: function lookup(value: unknown, path: string): unknown {
99:   return path.split(".").reduce((result, key) => getProperty(result, key), value);
100: }

102: function resolve(path: string, context: Context): unknown {
103:   if (path === "this") return context.value;
104:   if (path === "@index") return context.index;
105:   const local = lookup(context.value, path);
106:   return local === undefined ? lookup(context.root, path) : local;
107: }
108: 
109: function scalar(value: unknown): string {
110:   if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
111:   if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "bigint") return String(value);
112:   throw new Error(`Cannot render ${typeof value} as scalar text`);
113: }

115: function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
116:   return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[character]!);
117: }
118: 
119: function truthy(value: unknown): boolean {
120:   return !(value === "" || value === 0 || value === false || value === null || value === undefined || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0));
121: }
122: 
123: function renderNodes(nodes: Node[], context: Context): string {
124:   return nodes.map(node => {
125:     if (node.type === "text") return node.value;
126:     if (node.type === "value") {
127:       const value = scalar(resolve(node.path, context));
128:       return node.escaped ? escapeHtml(value) : value;
129:     }
130:     const value = resolve(node.path, context);
131:     if (node.kind === "if") return renderNodes(truthy(value) ? node.body : node.alternate ?? [], context);
132:     if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) return renderNodes(node.alternate ?? [], context);

134:   }).join("");
